positions.title: Travel
positions.description:
I embarked on a journey around the world, starting in South America and traveling westward through New Zealand, Southeast and South Asia, the Middle East, and Europe. Along the way, I visited 30 countries, tackled some of the world’s top treks, took up scuba diving and surfing, explored ancient ruins, and immersed myself in diverse cuisines and cultures. I also formed lasting friendships with people from all corners of the globe. This experience greatly improved my adaptability, cross-cultural communication skills, and deepened my appreciation for the shared humanity of people, regardless of their backgrounds.

Throughout the year, I also sought out various volunteer and professional opportunities, including:
 • Gaining hands-on experience with organic farming in New Zealand, where I learned sustainable agricultural practices
 • Participating in humanitarian work with Community Peacemaker Teams in Israel/Palestine
 • Taking on freelance software projects to stay current with evolving technology and sharpen my skills

positions.title: Co-Founder
positions.description:
FitTraction is building mobile apps that focus on shareable, trackable workouts in a local context. Unlike other fitness apps you're not just getting a digital workout logger. With FItTraction it's your trainer at your gym making your routines, holding you accountable, and keeping you motivated.

Website: FitTraction.com

positions.title: Business Development Manager
positions.description: The React Mobile platform is helping to make tomorrow a safer place. The React solution combines powerful software and connected devices to transform the way people call for help in emergencies. We are providing mobile security and peace of mind to millions of active smartphone users. React Mobile technology is being licensed to organizations who are developing apps that are “Powered by React Mobile” and over time our data aggregation platform will gather useful information that will help to improve the safety of our communities. React Mobile can help save lives. You can learn more at www.reactmobile.com

positions.title: Assistant Basketball Coach
positions.description: Assistant basketball coach for the boys Junior Varsity and Varsity teams at King's High School. In charge of the development of post players. Placed 2nd in the State Tournament in first two years as a coach.

positions.title: Commercial Account Manager
positions.description: Provided customer service to all of the agency's commercial accounts. Worked closely with the head of the agency's Commercial Insurance Department, and regularly communicated with customers via phone and email. Streamlined the process of renewing clients policies. Handled creating invoices, solving billing issues, generating insurance certificates, and creating visually appealing coverage summaries.
